description:
EMILDAI sits at the crossroads of law, data protection and AI, offered by six partner universities led from Avignon. Applications for the 2027/2029 editions open in November 2026; the previous round closed on 25 January 2026, a date the new cycle is expected to mirror.

Programme Highlights

  • Six-university consortium at the law-AI-data interface
  • November 2026 opening with a late-January closing pattern
  • Study tracks in data governance, AI law and cybersecurity
  • Graduates enter privacy offices, AI-regulation roles and tech policy

Who Should Apply

Law and computing graduates are both admitted, with study tracks designed for each stream; the consortium values interdisciplinary motivation.

Funding and Costs

Scholarships for the first round: partial fee waivers and EMJM-funded places depending on the edition.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply on the EMILDAI site once the November window opens and target the late-January scholarship deadline. Key deadline information: 25 January 2027 (expected — applications open November 2026; the 2026-2028 round closed 25 January 2026).
